findings.title: Failed tiny-proof publication remains admissible to the full-fit proof gate
findings.requirement: task-d-brief.md:67-71: retain an accepted current-identity tiny checkpoint before full fitting; retain failed attempts and publish no successful gating receipt if final readback fails. TRAINING.md:66-70 makes the same fail-closed claim.
findings.mechanism: Tiny completion still calls the protected d.publish_json. After os.link creates tiny-proof.json, a readback OSError followed by cleanup PermissionError leaves that final proof and its pending file. _training_failure successfully retains failure.json, but _verify_tiny never checks that disposition. Once the transient faults clear, it reloads the checkpoint and returns tiny_proven from the failed run. _full_execute calls precisely this gate before building its new model. The same absence of disposition checking is present on the real path; the reviewer exercised only the explicitly synthetic backend seam.
findings.observation: The new single bounded probe asserts injection after final link/pending and cleanup entry. It observed retained proof+failure.json, the cleanup exception recorded as main failure, and subsequent _verify_tiny acceptance with no artifact rewrite. Its expected-denial assertion failed:1 test/1 failure/0 errors/0 skips/exit1. No TensorFlow import, real array/model read, production CLI admission, actual full fit or real-source gate transition occurred.
findings.materiality: This is cross-component fail-closed gate correctness, not a numeric learning claim. It occurs while failure.json persistence succeeds, without crash, hostile writer or permanent media loss; the documented simultaneous inability to revoke AND persist failure exclusion does not cover it.
findings.expected_behavior: A failed tiny attempt must remain non-gating on subsequent proof consumption, even if a completion artifact could not be removed. Any authorized resolution needs regression coverage at this caller/consumer boundary; no source fix is performed or authorized here.
findings.scope: Newly reproduced trainer/proof-consumer finding. It does not reopen the resolved evaluator D-R1-001/D-R2-001 mechanisms, allege a synthetic-to-real CLI bypass, or claim real fitting occurred.
